in_arabic.name: عجمي
in_arabic.long_meaning: معنى: هو اسم يأتي من الجذر عجم، ومعناه المثنى غير العربي، الأجنبي. ويستخدم في القرآن الكريم للإشارة إلى غير العرب، مثل: (وَقَالَتِ الْأَعْرَابُ أَهَانَ بَنُو عَيْمَنَ وَأَخَذْنَ بِالأَمْرِ وَكَانَ أَمْرُهُمْ بَعدُ قَرِيحًا) [الفرقان: 54]. ويستخدم في التراث الإسلامي للإشارة إلى الأجنبي، والمستعرب، والمستعارب. ويعد من أسماء الحمايه، ويجوز اسماعه.

in_urdu.name: عجمی
in_urdu.meaning: معنی: غیر عرب، غیر ملکی، غیر ملحد
in_urdu.long_meaning: معنی: عجمی نام یہ عجم کے نام سے ماخوذ ہے جس کے معنی غیر عرب، غیر ملکی، غیر ملحد ہیں۔ اس نام سے غیر عربوں اور غیر ملک لوگوں کو کہا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अजमी
in_hindi.long_meaning: अर्थ: अजमी नाम का अर्थ है गैर-अरब, गैर-देशी, गैर-मुस्लिम। यह नाम तुर्की और फारसी भाषाओं में पाया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عجمی
in_pashto.long_meaning: ډهلي: عجمی نام دا معنا غیر عرب، غیر ملکی دی، چې د غیر عربو او غیر ملکو ته کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Ajamy
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ajamy originates from the Arabic root 'ajam', meaning non-Arab, foreigner, or non-Muslim. In Islamic tradition, it refers to non-Arabs, foreigners, or non-Muslims. It is considered an honorific name and is permissible to use.

pronunciation.urdu: عجمی کی صوتی اہمیت اردو میں
pronunciation.pashto: عجمی دې تلفظ کړه په پښتو کې

data.cultural_impact: The name Ajamy is of Arabic origin and translates to 'Trustworthy'. This name reflects the cultural values of Arabic and Islamic societies, which place high importance on trustworthiness, reliability, and honesty. In religious and secular contexts, being trustworthy is considered a virtue, and individuals who possess this trait are sought out and respected for their dependability.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ajamy holds spiritual significance as it shows a deeper connection to one's character and identity. In Islamic tradition, trustworthiness is not only a trait that earns respect from others but also an essential quality of a believer. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) taught that believers are those who fulfill the trusts that are entrusted to them. Thus, the name Ajamy can be seen as a reminder of one's responsibility towards Allah and others and the importance of staying true to one's faith and commitments. Moreover, being trustworthy also conveys a sense of strength and security in the perceived provider, a reflection of Allah's endless mercy and care for His creation.
